messages:
maya: @here Game 7 on Thursday — thinking projector + patio? I can bring a collapsible screen and a mini fridge. Also: fantasy trade deadline tonight 11:59pm. Last call for any desperate pickups. :popcorn:
eli: I’m down for patio. What time is tipoff?
maya: 7:30pm tipoff, so aiming to start setup ~6:15. Patio gate code is 4721.
sanjay: I’ll bring a bluetooth speaker and a giant bag of tortilla chips. Nacho mountain incoming. :nachos:
devon: I have an HDMI dongle and spare extension cord if anyone needs.
marina: can we keep it PG? last time the victory chant got a bit loud during a client call… :sweat_smile:
snack-bot: Snack sign-up created: https://rwdx.internal/snacks/1764321000 — add what you’re bringing!
eli: also FYI — thinking of dropping J. Smith to snag W. Adams before deadline. Anyone want to trade/bench help?
sanjay: take W. Adams if healthy. big upside. check injury report though.
maya: quick poll: reply with `patio` or `room` — need a final decision by Tue noon.
devon: patio
marina: room (got a late call that night — might need the conference for 30m)
eli: patio :thumbsup:
maya: tally so far — patio 3, room 1. patio winning but will respect if more room votes come in.
eli: also here’s my emergency lineup if anyone wants to mock before deadline: ```QB: Mahomes
RB1: D. Johnson
RB2: C. Elliott
WR1: A. Brown
WR2: K. Jefferson
Flex: T. Higgins```
devon: bench is stacked, not fair. See y’all on Thursday — I’ll bring an extra blanket and a tarp in case the weather throws a tantrum. :umbrella:
maya: awesome. final call: patio wins. projector + snacks + slightly-too-loud cheering. see you 6:15! :fire:
